svg.title: Information flow of an AI assistant prompt, with harness boundary
svg.desc: Snake-shaped flowchart in 16:10. Top row: input box and client request on the device, network, then server intake, whose arrow enters the dashed harness frame at its top edge. Inside the frame, context assembly feeds the model, and a loop runs from the model to tools, through context update and back to the model. An arrow leaves the frame's left edge to stream back, then render, with a dashed next-turn arrow back to the input box.
